description: This file defines various classes related to serializing and deserializing web request and response bodies, including text, file, and JSON bodies, with support for hashing/signing. It is part of the WPEFramework Web namespace and includes classes like TextBody, FileBody, JSONBodyType, and their signed variants, as well as related hashing mechanisms.

classes.name: TextBody
classes.description: A class representing a text-based request or response body, supporting serialization, deserialization, and clearing of text data.

classes.name: SignedTextBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending TextBody to include hashing/signing capabilities using a specified hash algorithm.

classes.name: FileBody
classes.description: A class representing a file-based body, supporting serialization and deserialization of file contents, with file management features.

classes.name: SignedFileBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending FileBody to include hashing/signing capabilities using a specified hash algorithm.

classes.name: JSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class for JSON object bodies, supporting serialization to string, deserialization, and JSON-specific operations.

classes.name: SignedJSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending JSONBodyType to include hashing/signing capabilities using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the body content into a stream or buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream or buffer into the body content.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Provides access to the hashing object for signing or verification.
